Then you're right with us! As a business analyst:in payments with focus on business customer, you are driving forward the implementation and optimization of modern payment solutions. In close cooperation with interdisciplinary teams and stakeholders, you ensure that our solutions meet the highest standards and optimally meet the needs of our business customers. A varied environment awaits you in which you master new challenges, introduce ideas and shape the future together with a dedicated team. Mansioni - Analysis and collection of payment requirements, especially for business customers, taking into account technical and functional specifications - Ensuring compliance with standards and regulatory requirements in the processing of payment messages (e.g. pain.001, camt.053, MT101, etc) - Support in the implementation and optimization of payment solutions via channels such as e-banking, business banking and SWIFT for corporates - Implementation of market and competition analyses to identify trends and innovations - Point of contact in the last instance for support requests from the operating operation (Focus customer bank notifications)
